hooks.command: h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/governance/kernel/hooks/pretooluse.py"; c="$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)"; g="$c/gov/bin/gov"; [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$g" ] || g="$HOME/.local/bin/gov"; [ -f "$g" ] || g="$(command -v gov)" || { echo "gov hook: no gov at ${c:-(no git repository)}/gov/bin/gov, $HOME/.local/bin/gov or on PATH, so $h was not run" >&2; exit 0; }; { read -r p; read -r q; } < "$g"; p="${p#'#!'}"; [ "$p" != /bin/sh ] || { q="${q#"'''exec' "}"; q="${q%' "$0" "$@"'}"; q="${q#\"}"; p="${q%\"}"; }; [ -x "$p" ] || { echo "gov hook: $g names no interpreter that runs: $p, so $h cannot run; refused" >&2; exit 2; }; "$p" -E "$h"; r=$?; case $r in 0|2) exit $r;; esac; echo "gov hook: $h ended with exit $r (it could not run or crashed); refused" >&2; exit 2
